name: Lake Everstill
summary: Murlocs and lake beasts threaten Lake Everstill beside Lakeshire. Its clear mountain waters once drew anglers, but now the shores and depths are perilous.

sections.title: Heart of the Valley
sections.body: Lake Everstill fills Redridge's central basin beside Lakeshire. Clear water runs east toward Stonewatch, and a bridge crosses the lake at the heart of town. For years, the lake supported local trade and gave anglers a quiet place to fish. Now danger has broken the calm along its shores.

sections.title: Trouble in the Depths
sections.body: Murlocs have made camps in the northern and eastern shallows. They disrupt trade and harry fishermen. Farther down, dangerous threshers patrol the deep water.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes crowd the shallows, with scouts, tidecallers, and flesheaters among them. Giant threshers and aggressive muckdwellers patrol below the surface.

faq.q: Where does the water from Lake Everstill flow?
faq.answer: An eastern river carries Lake Everstill's water past the slopes below Stonewatch, a stronghold held by Blackrock.

faq.q: Can you fish safely in Lake Everstill?
aliases: is it safe to fish lakeshire
faq.answer: Catfish and sagefish fill the lake, but fishing there has become dangerous. Murloc raiding parties camp along the shore, and large threshers attack anyone who ventures too far into deep water.

angles.text: As a mage passing through Lakeshire, you will find the lake's dangers mundane, not arcane. Murloc camps crowd the shallows, while threshers patrol the deeper water.
As an Alliance member, you know Lakeshire's survival depends on control of the lake and its crossings. Coordinated incursions by Redridge murlocs and nearby Blackrock orcs threaten that control.
